objective: container_02 holds 560 uL of AVL lysis buffer. The assay needs 140 uL of sample from container_03 added to it, mixed and left to stand, and then 560 uL from container_01 added, mixed and left to stand again. Each mix is 15 s on the vortex station and each stand is 600 s at room_temperature, and the tube has to be closed while it is mixed or standing. How you carry out the transfers is your decision.
operating_notes: Report finish when the preparation is complete.
